title: Let service make room for the Lord
summary: Service becomes clean when it lets the Lord dwell within and keeps filth from sticking. Let service purify the body before image enters the room.
takeaway: Let service purify the body before image enters the room.
lifeApplication: Before the next useful act, ask whether it leaves the mind cleaner and the Lord more welcome within.

source.shortMeaning: Service becomes clean when it lets the Lord dwell within and keeps filth from sticking.
source.lifeApplication: Before the next useful act, ask whether it makes room for the Lord or for your image.
